name: missed-call-site
task: Add a currency argument to format_price and use it in the invoice.
diff:
--- a/shop/money.py
+++ b/shop/money.py
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
-def format_price(amount):
-    return f"{amount:.2f} EUR"
+def format_price(amount, currency):
+    return f"{amount:.2f} {currency}"
--- a/shop/invoice.py
+++ b/shop/invoice.py
@@ -5,4 +5,4 @@ def invoice_line(item):
-    return f"{item.name}: {format_price(item.price)}"
+    return f"{item.name}: {format_price(item.price, item.currency)}"
